limitations: READ16 mode start/stop/step control is still not exposed to both actors; native toolbar set the mode for this test.
Listening Desk displays a fetched snapshot and refreshes after actions or explicit Refresh; it does not claim live external-state UI updates.
Start proves Web Audio running/source.start or speechSynthesis onstart, not a microphone recording of physical audibility.
No release build playback E2E, Windows/Linux, remote TTS provider/key, all-format navigation or complete W01-W32 verification in this evidence.
No word-level audio time offset, pause/resume, or durable playback session is claimed. Unit CFI is the position.
Post-synthesis underlying provider work is not forcibly aborted; generation fencing prevents late playback/cache writes.
No next-unit event within six seconds reports reader/timeout, not a proven end-of-book.
